lines.t: Soft steps in the quiet, unseen in the crowd
A voice held back, never reaching out loud
Low to the ground where the stillness remains
Moving in silence, untouched by the praise
Not chasing a name, not carving a throne
Humble in heart, he is not his own
Humble and waiting, steady and true
When the call comes down, he moves into view
He doesn’t run, he doesn’t hide
He walks the line he’s given to guide
Humble and waiting, steady and true
Nothing to prove, nothing to lose
He hears the call and answers the same
Never for glory, never for name
Carrying love that he never displays
Hidden devotion in shadowed ways
Not bending his will to the pull of desire
But yielding it all to a higher fire
No rush in his step, no need to be seen
Humble and faithful in all in between
Humble and waiting, steady and true
When the call comes down, he moves into view
He doesn’t run, he doesn’t hide
He walks the line he’s given to guide
Humble and waiting, steady and true
Nothing to prove, nothing to lose
He hears the call and answers the same
Never for glory, never for name
When the calling falls heavy and fills up the air
He rises at once, without pause or care
No question, no turning, no drifting away
Just walking the path he was given to stay
Quiet… but present
Still… yet burning deeper
Called… and he answers
Humble and waiting, steady and true
When the call comes down, he moves into view
He doesn’t run, he doesn’t hide
He walks the line he’s given to guide
Humble and waiting, steady and true
Nothing to prove, nothing to lose
He hears the call and answers the same
Never for glory, never for name
A friend in the silence, a soul set apart
Moving in rhythm with an unseen heart
